binding.index: strict integer, nonnegative, below queries length

query_only: must be literal true; does not authorize PRAGMA as a SELECT
count_key_policy: For every binding, count and row_count each retain actual source presence, strict integer type, nonnegative value and equality to the full preserved row length. A params-to-parameters binding copies both count spellings without renaming either.
SELECT_only: Both bind_query and the unchanged verifier retain the existing SELECT prefix requirement. PRAGMA query_only stays in separate-control-evidence.json and its complete copied original descriptor.
projection_requirement: The frozen reconciled normalized count-only replays must not be edited. Create separately pinned projection files with exactly the original source count-key presence, identical SQL/parameters/full rows, and explicit original-descriptor/index plus normalized-replay/full-pin provenance. For these Tibetan/English originals use row_count and omit count. A count-only normalized replay directly bound to a row_count descriptor is refused.

proof_reader.name: proof_counts(report,seq)
proof_reader.current: Direct spans/nulls/d5_nonnull with exact PASS_ACTUAL_CANONICAL_AND_FULL_SOURCE_REPRODUCTION status and integer matching seq.
proof_reader.prior: Nested counts DICT may retain its extra metadata; seq remains strictly typed and equal.
proof_reader.shared: Reject missing, Boolean, noninteger, negative, impossible bounds and mixed direct/nested count sources; compare to the unchanged configured count row before the existing spec checks.

authorized_handoff_scope: The root-authorized runtime-schema-handoff.json reports 209 SELECT +1 PRAGMA overall. This preparation directly binds/controls the 140 original SELECT descriptors; the additional reconciler SELECT descriptors remain for the separate config-construction/validation phase. No statement that all 209 have been validated here.
